title: About Us – Triangle films
text:
About Us – Triangle films

### ABOUT US

At Triangle Films, storytelling is at the heart of everything we do. Since 2012, we have been partnering with brands to craft creative content that inspires, engages, and grows businesses.

From our humble beginnings to becoming a trusted creative partner, our journey has been fueled by passion, innovation, and a deep understanding of brand storytelling. Over the years, we have created a wide range of content from high-impact commercials, animated films, brand films, corporate films, to engaging explainer videos.

Our team of talented filmmakers, animators, writers, and producers work together to bring ideas to life with precision, creativity, and emotion. Every frame we create is designed to not just tell a story but to leave a lasting impression.

At Triangle Films, we don’t just create content we build connections between brands and their audiences. Driven by creativity. Powered by collaboration. Focused on your growth.

## HOW WEADD VALUETO YOUR BRAND

Curious about process and timelines?

### Creative

Development/ Ideation Concept Treatment Scripts.

### Pre-Production

Location Scouting, Casting, Shoot schedule, Logistic, Prep.

### Production

TVS, Digital, Corporate, Testimonial Films & Social Media Videos.

### Post-Production

Editing, Online, Motion Graphics, 3D Animation, Grading/DI, SFX/Mix & Mastering & Voice Over.
